title: Local Git Initialization
purpose: Defines deterministic local Git establishment within the complete staging workspace.

normative_requirements.text: The local Git initialization component shall initialize the complete staged content as the deterministic local Git repository defined by `product.local-git-repository` before repository validation begins.

The component shall verify the branch, root commit count, commit tree, identities, timestamps, clean worktree, and absence of remotes, and shall fail without promoting the destination when any required Git state differs.

conformance.rationale: Current accepted repo-spec authority declares no governed generic product implementation-test obligation for this requirement at product/scripts/test-product; source-development tests and validation self-tests are separate surfaces. Future activation requires a governed correspondence update.
